

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Water Rat|kanji=壬子|romaji=mizunoe nezumi|onyomi=jinshi|p=rénzǐ|w=jen-tzŭ|mi=ʐən³⁵ tsɨ|y=jam4 zi2|j=jam4 zi2|ci=jɐm tsi|mc=ɲiɪm tsi|oc-bs=ɲɨm tsi}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Water Rat''' (壬子, ''mizunoe nezumi''; onyomi ''jinshi'') is the 49th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 49th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Pig|af|Metaalvark (astrologie)|cdo|Sĭng-hâi|de|Metall-Schwein|eo|Xinhai|hak|Sîn-hoi|ja|辛亥|ko|신해|vi|Tân Hợi|za|Sinhaih|zh|辛亥|zh_min_nan|Sin-hāi|zh_yue|辛亥|qid=Q905052}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Ox|ja|癸丑}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''子'' (Rat) is Yang Water; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.
==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Rat (壬子)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénzǐ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 zi2
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-nezumi
*** On'yomi: jinshi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): imja (임자)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Tý

==Years of Yang Water Rat==
A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 52 when divided by 60 is a year of Yang Water Rat (壬子).

==Months of Yang Water Rat==
Because the water element is duplicated, a superstition arose that while many fires occur in {{ill|Yang Fire Horse|ja|丙午}} years, many water disasters ({{ill|water-related disaster|ja|水害|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11252966}}) occur in {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子}} years. In the late Edo period, {{ill|Takizawa Bakin|en|Takizawa Bakin|qid=Q463142|lt=Kyokutei Bakin}} remarked, "If it is so with a Besshi year, then in a Jinshi year the double presence of water elements will surely bring about a great flood."

However, the superstition that "men born in a Jinshi year have weak constitutions" did not spread; for instance, in {{ill|1972|en|1972|qid=Q2476|lt=1972 AD}} (Shōwa 47), nearly 2 million births occurred during a Jinshi year as part of the second {{ill|Baby boom|en|Baby boom|qid=Q610548|lt=Baby Boom}}, and there are no recorded instances from {{ill|1852|en|1852|qid=Q7661|lt=1852 AD}} (Kaei 5) or {{ill|1912|en|1912|qid=Q2077|lt=1912 AD}} (Meiji 45/Taishō 1) of men being unable to marry due to being born in a Jinshi year.

==Days of Yang Water Rat==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 2 or 7 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)}}), the month of {{ill|November|en|November|qid=Q125|lt=November}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Lesser Cold}}) as applicable.

==Yang Water Rat (壬子)'s Days==
==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
The selected day for {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子}} is the 1st day of {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専}}.
